name: The Carvings on the Wall
content: "I am looking for a way out of here. I am Shiro. Daughter of Waen."
"The same words — I no longer know how many times I have written them."
"The scars on the wall do not fade. My memory does."
"In the next room, there is something. I am not afraid. I tried speaking to it."
"The same words my father carved into the monument."
note: Physical traces Shiro has left across countless loops. A new line is added every time.
